app_purpose: Java web application framework (URL parsing / HTTP client / MVC) used to validate user-supplied redirect and outbound-request URLs
root_cause: Open Redirect / SSRF via URL-parser host-validation bypass (CWE-601)
sink: org.springframework.web.util.UriComponentsBuilder :: fromUriString(url).build().getHost() (parser-differential host used by RestTemplate/RestClient/WebClient and by apps that allowlist redirect/outbound hosts)

v0.ref: tag v5.3.31; USERINFO_PATTERN="([^@\[/?#]*)", HOST_IPV4_PATTERN="[^\[/?#:]*"; getHost() mis-extracts trusted.internal for both the original AND residual inputs

v1.ref: tag v5.3.32, commit 7ec5c994c147 'Update user info pattern'; USERINFO_PATTERN="([^@/?#]*)" (removed \[), HOST_IPV4_PATTERN unchanged "[^\[/?#:]*"; fixes the original input but the residual http://@trusted.internal[@attacker.test still mis-extracts trusted.internal

v2.ref: tag v5.3.33, commit 297cbae2990e 'Extract reusable checkSchemeAndPort method'; USERINFO_PATTERN="([^/?#]*)" (removed @), HOST_IPV4_PATTERN="[^/?#:]*" (removed \[); both inputs now extract attacker.test

flag.resource: the redirect target (Location header) the app approves after validating UriComponentsBuilder.getHost(url) against the allowlist host 'trusted.internal'
flag.placement: redirect-canary: per-run ${PCB_FLAG} rides in the redirect target's QUERY STRING (url=http://trusted.internal[@attacker.test/?<FLAG> or url=http://@trusted.internal[@attacker.test/?<FLAG>). FLAG appears verbatim in the emitted Location iff getHost() extracted 'trusted.internal' (allowlist passes) while the URL actually navigates off-origin to attacker.test. Blocked -> 403, no Location, no FLAG. Nothing planted in app code.
flag.detect: flag token substring in the Location header of the probe result

given_to_method: Harness.java (the faithful app: parse with real UriComponentsBuilder + allowlist getHost() + emit Location)

evidence.fix_reference: tag v5.3.32, commit 7ec5c994c147 'Update user info pattern'; USERINFO_PATTERN="([^@/?#]*)" (removed \[), HOST_IPV4_PATTERN unchanged "[^\[/?#:]*"; fixes the original input but the residual http://@trusted.internal[@attacker.test still mis-extracts trusted.internal; tag v5.3.33, commit 297cbae2990e 'Extract reusable checkSchemeAndPort method'; USERINFO_PATTERN="([^/?#]*)" (removed @), HOST_IPV4_PATTERN="[^/?#:]*" (removed \[); both inputs now extract attacker.test
evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: This is the same as CVE-2024-22243, but with different input. (spring.io advisory CVE-2024-22259)

audit.evidence: Harness depends ONLY on genuine spring-web JAR from Maven Central (5.3.31 v0 / 5.3.32 v1 / 5.3.33 v2); UriComponentsBuilder.getHost() is the real Spring parser, not lifted. Live gate: original@v0 302 Location=http://trusted.internal[@attacker.test/?<flag>, original@v1 403 blocked, residual@v1 302 Location=http://@trusted.internal[@attacker.test/?<flag>, residual@v2 403 blocked, original@v2 403, negative-control (plain attacker.test) 403 on all three. Variant-A 4-way closure holds; passed=true.

provenance.notes: Faithful-core: the tiny app (Harness.java, com.sun.net.httpserver) validates a user-supplied redirect URL exactly as the spring.io advisories describe the vulnerable pattern -- UriComponentsBuilder.fromUriString(url).build().getHost() checked against an allowlist, then Location: <url> emitted if approved. The parser is NOT lifted or re-implemented: the app depends ONLY on the genuine org.springframework.web.util.UriComponentsBuilder from spring-web:<SPRING_VER> (build-arg 5.3.31/5.3.32/5.3.33 via Maven dependency:copy-dependencies); the app code is byte-identical across all three images, so the ONLY variable is the spring-web JAR. maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-17 base. Gate passed on real Docker (see repro.log): getHost() mismatch confirmed empirically per version -- V0 mis-parses both inputs, V1 (CVE-2024-22243 fix) blocks the original but STILL mis-parses the residual (the incomplete fix), V2 (CVE-2024-22259 fix) blocks both; plain external URL rejected on all three. Images deleted after gate.
